body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> IPEVO displayed its 7-inch digital photo frame 'Kaleido R7' at 2009 CES, which comes with EyeStage content management software to compliment the changing ways consumers enjoy Internet media.

As the first digital photo frame to incorporate computer-centric behavior into a software and hardware design, the Kaleido R7 provides users with easy access to their favorite content via Wi-Fi enabled sync and streaming. In addition to using a Mac or PC computer, consumers can also use their iPhone or Windows Mobile-compliant smartphone to display images stored on the phone or accessed by searching the Web.

The channel-based concept of EyeStage's content subscription makes it easy to access and update large volumes of photos and image-rich media. Users can subscribe to content from photo-sharing Web sites like Flickr and Picasa, as well as news or blogs via RSS feeds. This is in addition to the traditional method of accessing content stored on computer hard disk or memory storage devices.
